name: MonarchBarList
title: BarList
wrapsNative: VStack of rows, each with a bar drawn in background(_:); Button for tappable rows
summary: A ranked list with a bar behind each row's label: top pages, top referrers, rivals by score.
whenToUse: To compare up to a dozen named values where the names matter as much as the sizes.
whenNotToUse: For values over time, use a sparkline or a chart. For a scrolling list of many rows with swipe actions, use a List and draw the bar in the row yourself.
api: MonarchBarList.init(_ label: String? = nil, items: [MonarchBarListItem], sort: MonarchBarListSort = .descending, maximum: Double? = nil, limit: Int? = nil, isRanked: Bool = false, isLoading: Bool = false, loadingRows: Int = 5, error: String? = nil, isRetrying: Bool = false, missingLabel: String? = nil, emptyLabel: String? = nil, loadingLabel: String? = nil, overflowLabel: String? = nil, retryLabel: String? = nil, formatValue: ((Double) -> String)? = nil, onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onSelect: (@MainActor (MonarchBarListItem) -> Void)? = nil)
MonarchBarListItem.init(_ label: String, id: String? = nil, value: Double?, description: String? = nil, systemImage: String? = nil, displayValue: String? = nil, isHighlighted: Bool = false)

options.name: label
options.description: Names the list for VoiceOver, such as "Top pages".

options.name: sort
options.description: descending, ascending or none. Rows without a value go last.

options.name: maximum
options.description: The value of a full bar. The largest value when nil. Pass 1 for ratios of a whole.

options.name: limit
options.description: Shows only the first rows, with a "Top 5 of 12" footer.

options.name: isLoading
options.description: Shows redacted placeholder rows instead of the rows. VoiceOver reads Loading.

options.name: loadingRows
options.description: How many placeholder rows to show while loading, from 1 to 12.

options.name: error
options.description: A message shown instead of the rows when they could not be loaded. With onRetry it is a MonarchInlineErrorRetry.

options.name: isRetrying
options.description: Whether a retry is running. The retry button waits and reads Retrying.

options.name: retryLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in title Try again of the retry button.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Adds a retry button to the error. Pass it with its label, onRetry:.

options.name: missingLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in spoken text "No value".

options.name: emptyLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in text "No data yet".

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Writes a value. The default is a number in the current locale.

states.name: default
states.description: Rows sorted by value, each with a bar as long as its share of the largest value.

states.name: highlighted row
states.description: A stronger bar and a heavier label and value.

states.name: missing value
states.description: A dash instead of the value and no bar.

states.name: loading
states.description: Redacted placeholder rows, read as one Loading element.

appearance: Bars use the accent subtle colour behind default text; a highlighted row uses the stronger accent subtle colour and semibold text. Ranks, descriptions and the footer are muted text, in every theme.
platformNotes: The web draws the bar on a track under the label or inline; here the bar is behind the label, the usual form on a narrow screen, so there is no layout option. The web formats numbers, percentages and currencies from options; here formatValue takes a closure, so an app writes $0.formatted(.percent) or a currency style itself. Row links (href) become onSelect, because navigation in an app is not a URL. Like the web, loading draws skeleton rows and a failed load shows MonarchInlineErrorRetry. Row icons are SF Symbols. The bar grows from the leading edge, so it is mirrored in right-to-left layouts. Android uses the same names. Several closures are optional (formatValue, onRetry, onSelect). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is formatValue.
accessibility: The list is an accessibility container with the given label.
Each row is one element: its label and description, then its value. A row without a value reads "No value".
Bars and rank numbers are not read; the order of the rows carries the rank.
With onSelect each row is a button with a touch target at least 44 points high.
A highlighted row is heavier as well as stronger in colour. The emphasis is not spoken, so say why in the label.
Labels scale with Dynamic Type and wrap.
edgeCases: Equal values keep the order they were given in.
Values that are not finite are treated as missing.
Negative values and an all-zero list draw no bars.
A value above maximum draws a full bar.
limit hides rows but the scale still uses the largest value of all items.
Item ids default to the label, so give an id when two rows have the same label.

examples.title: Top pages with links
examples.template:
MonarchBarList(
    {{label}},
    items: [
        MonarchBarListItem({{items.0.label}}, id: {{items.0.id}}, value: {{items.0.value|double}}),
        MonarchBarListItem({{items.1.label}}, id: {{items.1.id}}, value: {{items.1.value|double}}),
        MonarchBarListItem({{items.2.label}}, id: {{items.2.id}}, value: {{items.2.value|double}}),
        MonarchBarListItem({{items.3.label}}, id: {{items.3.id}}, value: {{items.3.value|double}}),
        MonarchBarListItem({{items.4.label}}, id: {{items.4.id}}, value: {{items.4.value|double}}),
    ],
    formatValue: { "\(Int($0).formatted(.number.locale(Locale(identifier: {{locale}})))) {{unit|raw}}" },
    onSelect: { _ in }
)
examples.code:
MonarchBarList(
    "Top pages",
    items: [
        MonarchBarListItem("/", id: "home", value: 4820.0),
        MonarchBarListItem("/pricing", id: "pricing", value: 2310.0),
        MonarchBarListItem("/docs/getting-started", id: "docs", value: 1640.0),
        MonarchBarListItem("/blog/release-notes", id: "blog", value: 920.0),
        MonarchBarListItem("/contact", id: "contact", value: 310.0),
    ],
    formatValue: { "\(Int($0).formatted(.number.locale(Locale(identifier: "en-US")))) views" },
    onSelect: { _ in }
)
